name: My Jadhu VR
summary:
Jadhu VR is a virtual reality learning platform designed to support skill development through engaging, interactive, and therapist-guided activities.
The application is intended for learners who receive personalized lessons and programs assigned by therapists through the Jadhu Therapist Portal. Once a lesson is assigned, learners can access and complete the activities within the Meta Quest headset using the Jadhu VR application.
